DX9EX-DISPATCH-XYZRHW-001: R30 Draw*Dest wrappers call matching R30TryXyzrhw* before R30GuardScreenSpace.
R31, R32 and R33 contain no R30TryXyzrhw* dispatch.
R33 final fallback explicitly invokes R30Draw*R29Hook, the R29 trampoline, rather than the R30 Draw*Dest wrapper.
R30 XYZRHW code explicitly distinguishes white HUD glyphs from CPU-projected smoke/skid/decal using a bounded Z/RHW projection signature.
DX9EX-SKYGLOW-001: Bright pass writes temp; horizontal blur writes reduced.
When effectiveTwoStep is false, compositeSource is temp, so horizontal blur output is skipped.
When effectiveTwoStep is true, vertical blur writes temp but compositeSource is changed to reduced, so vertical-final output is skipped.
The adjacent code comment says the vertical pass should be the composite source, contradicting the implementation.
